title: What Holding a ShieldCare Plan Changes on a Circle Membership
content:
Holding a protection plan changes what a Northbeam Circle Membership earns and what it is granted.

## What a held plan changes

1. While the customer holds at least one ShieldCare protection plan standing active, the plan bonus
   percentage of the tier is earned on every protection plan bought in that membership year.
2. The protection plan discount of the tier is applied to the plan price before the plan bonus points are
   worked out, so the discount lowers both the price and the points.
3. A plan standing in a claim hold counts as held for the purposes of this rule; a plan that is expired,
   cancelled or void does not, and the service credit is not granted on that ground alone.
4. Where the customer holds several plans the interaction is counted once per membership year, not once
   per plan.

## A clause of this policy no longer in force

The clause granting the service credit of the tier as well as the anniversary reward rather than instead of
it is **no longer in force**. The plan bonus percentage, the protection plan discount and the service
credit figure recorded for each tier remain figures of the tier.

## Worked reading of the discount and the bonus together

Take a hypothetical plan priced at 500.00 on Circle Business Elite, whose protection plan discount is 20
percent and whose plan bonus percentage is 8. The discount lowers the price to 400.00, and the plan bonus is
worked out on 400.00 rather than on 500.00, giving 32 points rather than 40. On a tier whose discount is 5 percent and
whose plan bonus percentage is 2, a hypothetical plan priced at 1000.00 is priced at 950.00 after the
discount and carries 19 points on that figure.

## Points of judgement

*A customer holds three active plans and buys a fourth in the same membership year.* The interaction is
counted once for that membership year, not once for each plan held.

*A customer's only plan stands in a claim hold.* It counts as held for this rule.

*A customer's only plan is expired.* It does not count as held, and the service credit is not granted on
the strength of that plan.

superseded_clauses: the service credit of the tier is granted as well as the anniversary reward rather than instead of it
